root_causes: Public playlist thumbnails were rendered in the small local navigation icon layout.
Queued native row resets could drop focus after the synchronous check.
Right-at-cap returned before consuming the explicit continuation signal.
A failed native publication could retain the global job or consume its cursor before publication succeeded.
The paging graphic hardcoded Next while the item caption said Retry.
independent_review: Approved after red-green cursor-rollback and ownership-after-dispatch regressions. All309 source hashes verified.
distribution: All three devices now exact candidate79. Published build1.1.9 and Installer1.0.15 remain pinned to manifest76; no release promotion performed.

mac.initial_provider_response_without_contin: One initial Strategy video games response lacked continuation content and correctly showed Retry. The complete fresh Home rerun passed; recovery of that exact opaque server cursor was not established.

limits: Bounded live signed-in Home validation. Finite provider shelves cannot supply additional items without a cursor. YouTube server failures can still require Retry or Refresh recommendations. This is not a long-duration soak or a new playback/performance benchmark.
